trend.title: OpenAI Launches Dots: Always-On GPT-6 Astra Agents
trend.rationale: OpenAI's launch of Dots, powered by GPT-6 Astra, represents a significant evolution in AI agents' capabilities, enabling always-on functionality. This could revolutionize how businesses use AI for customer engagement and retention, particularly in the APAC region where mobile and messaging-first strategies are prevalent.
signals: Potential impact on customer engagement strategies

evidence.claim: OpenAI launched Dots, powered by GPT-6 Astra.
evidence.support: The Verge article discusses the launch and capabilities of Dots, highlighting its always-on functionality and integration potential.
MarkTechPost article mentions the integration capabilities with numerous apps, emphasizing the system's flexibility.

risks: Dependence on OpenAI's infrastructure could pose risks if service disruptions occur.
Privacy and data security concerns with always-on AI agents.
